biggest_catch: You always sell below face value (up to 92% for top brands, 60-80% typical) — this only 'makes money' on cards you'd otherwise waste, never as a repeatable profit source.
catches: Offer rates vary by brand demand; niche brands fetch 60-70%, only top brands approach 92% — never face value.
This is converting an existing asset to cash at a loss, not earning income; only works if you already hold unwanted cards.
CardCash is not BBB-accredited and review sources note occasional balance disputes and payout delays; verify your card balance first.
Some physical cards must be mailed in, adding days before approval.
Resale spread is thin and never guaranteed; rates change with market supply/demand.

maximize: Run CardCash's instant quote first as your price floor, then check what the same card nets on Raise after its 15% cut — sell wherever the net is higher. Choose PayPal or ACH over mailed check to skip mail delay. If you'd shop at Amazon anyway, take the Amazon gift card payout option — sources cite up to 5% more value than cash.

steps: Go to cardcash.com and enter the merchant name and card balance
Get an instant cash offer (up to 92% of face value depending on brand demand)
Accept the offer and complete verification (card number/PIN checked, ID verification for larger amounts)
Choose payout: PayPal, ACH direct deposit, mailed check, or trade for another retailer's gift card
Receive payment within 1-2 business days of approval
timing: Paid within 1-2 business days after card approval via PayPal, ACH, or mailed check; trade-in for another brand's gift card available immediately on approval
who_pays: CardCash itself pays you — it buys your card outright and resells it later. No third-party buyer is involved.
who_qualifies: You must be 18 or older and in the US, with a gift card holding at least $10 from one of the 1,100+ accepted retailers. You'll need a valid credit card for identity verification (a $1 temporary authorization).
work_available: CardCash is an active, operating gift-card exchange — its homepage and sell terms were loaded live in September 2026.
what_gets_accepted: Your card is accepted only if its balance verifies (card number/PIN check), and larger amounts may require ID verification. Physical cards may need to be mailed in; cards that fail balance or ownership verification are rejected.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No selling fees — CardCash makes its money on the discount between face value and its offer. You'll spend unpaid time getting the quote, entering card details, and mailing physical cards if required.
when_cash_arrives: PayPal or ACH payment lands 1–2 business days after your card is approved. Mailed checks take longer; trading in for another retailer's gift card is instant on approval.
